```{r read_in_and_clean_cycle_data, include=F}
df <- readr::read_rds("data/clean_data/cld_filtered.rds") |> 
  dplyr::rename(pregnant = pregnant_bool)

egg_df = readr::read_rds("data/clean_data/cleaned_egg_level_df.rds")

df <- df %>%
  mutate(age_group = case_when(
    age < 35 ~ "<35",
    age >= 35 & age <= 37 ~ "35-37",
    age >= 38 & age <= 40 ~ "38-40",
    age >= 41 ~ "41+"
  ))

df$age_group <- as.factor(df$age_group)

# Number of unique PAT ids
df = df |> dplyr::mutate(the_year = lubridate::year(treatment_start_date))
```

```{r define_payment_functions}
# Single Cycle Egg (Tiered)
payout_egg_single <- function(eggs) {
  ifelse(eggs <= 2, 0.5,
        ifelse(eggs <= 4, 0.25,
                0))
}

# Multi-Cycle Egg
payout_egg_multi <- function(total_eggs) {
  ifelse(total_eggs < 10, 0.5,
        ifelse(total_eggs < 15, 0.25,
        0))
}

# Euploid Embryo
payout_euploid <- function(has_euploid) {
  ifelse(has_euploid == 0, 1.0, 0)
}

# Live Birth
payout_livebirth <- function(live_birth) {
  ifelse(live_birth == 0, 1.0, 0)
}

# Make patient grid.
ages <- seq(30, 42, by = 2)
amh_values <- c(0.3, 0.8, 2.0, 4.0)

patient_grid <- expand.grid(
  age = ages,
  amh = amh_values
)
```

# MODEL 1: SINGLE CYCLE EGG
```{r}
results_egg_single <- data.frame()



for (i in 1:nrow(patient_grid)) {

  print(i)
  
  row <- patient_grid[i, ]

  #----- MODEL INPUT REQUIRED  -----#
  # Replace with your fitted binomial model
  mu <- predict(nb_model,
                data.frame(age = row$age, AMH = row$amh),
                type = "response")

  theta <- nb_model$theta
  #----- END MODEL INPUT -----#

  eggs <- rnbinom(n_sim, size = theta, mu = mu)
  payout <- payout_egg_single(eggs)

  results_egg_single <- rbind(results_egg_single,
                              data.frame(
                                age = row$age,
                                amh_cat = row$amh_cat,
                                expected_payout = mean(payout)
                              ))
}

plot_egg_single <- ggplot(results_egg_single,
                          aes(x = age, y = expected_payout, color = amh_cat)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Single Cycle Egg Retrieval: Expected Payout",
    x = "Age (years)",
    y = "Expected Payout (% of Cycle Cost)",
    color = "AMH Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# MODEL 2: MULTI-CYCLE EGG
```{r}
results_egg_multi <- data.frame()
n_cycles <- 2

for (i in 1:nrow(patient_grid)) {

  row <- patient_grid[i, ]

  #----- MODEL INPUT REQUIRED  -----#
  # Replace with your fitted binomial model
  mu <- predict(nb_model,
                data.frame(age = row$age, AMH = row$amh),
                type = "response")

  theta <- nb_model$theta
  #----- END MODEL INPUT -----#

  total_eggs <- replicate(n_sim, {
    sum(rnbinom(n_cycles, size = theta, mu = mu))
  })

  payout <- payout_egg_multi(total_eggs)

  results_egg_multi <- rbind(results_egg_multi,
                             data.frame(
                               age = row$age,
                               amh_cat = row$amh_cat,
                               expected_payout = mean(payout)
                             ))
}

plot_egg_multi <- ggplot(results_egg_multi,
                         aes(x = age, y = expected_payout, color = amh_cat)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Multi-Cycle Egg Retrieval: Expected Payout",
    x = "Age (years)",
    y = "Expected Payout (% of Total Cost)",
    color = "AMH Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# MODEL 3: EUPLOID EMBRYO GUARANTEE

```{r}

results_euploid <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:nrow(patient_grid)) {

  row <- patient_grid[i, ]

  #----- MODEL INPUT REQUIRED  -----#
  # Replace with your fitted binomial model
  p_euploid <- predict(euploid_model,
                       data.frame(age = row$age, AMH = row$amh),
                       type = "response")
  #----- END MODEL INPUT -----#

  has_euploid <- rbinom(n_sim, 1, p_euploid)
  payout <- payout_euploid(has_euploid)

  results_euploid <- rbind(results_euploid,
                           data.frame(
                             age = row$age,
                             amh_cat = row$amh_cat,
                             expected_payout = mean(payout)
                           ))
}

plot_euploid <- ggplot(results_euploid,
                       aes(x = age, y = expected_payout, color = amh_cat)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Euploid Embryo Guarantee: Expected Payout",
    x = "Age (years)",
    y = "Probability of Payout",
    color = "AMH Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


# MODEL 4: CLINICAL PREGNANCY GUARANTEE

```{r}
results_preg <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:nrow(patient_grid)) {

  row <- patient_grid[i, ]

  #----- MODEL INPUT REQUIRED  -----#
  # Model predicts probability of clinical pregnancy (pregnant = 1)
  p_pregnant <- predict(lb_model,
                        data.frame(age = row$age, AMH = row$amh),
                        type = "response")
  #----- END MODEL INPUT -----#

  # Simulate clinical pregnancy outcome
  clinical_pregnancy <- rbinom(n_sim, 1, p_pregnant)

  # Use as proxy for live birth (can be adjusted later)
  payout <- payout_preg(clinical_pregnancy)

  results_preg <- rbind(results_preg,
                             data.frame(
                               age = row$age,
                               amh_cat = row$amh_cat,
                               expected_payout = mean(payout)
                             ))
}

plot_preg <- ggplot(results_preg,
                         aes(x = age, y = expected_payout, color = amh_cat)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Clinical Pregnancy Guarantee: Expected Payout",
    x = "Age (years)",
    y = "Probability of Payout",
    color = "AMH Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
